title: Real-time fMRI Neurofeedback in Patients With Schizophrenia and Auditory Hallucinations
official: Real-time fMRI Neurofeedback as a Tool to Mitigate Auditory Hallucinations in Patients With Schizophrenia - R33 Phase
summary: Neurofeedback intervention aimed to regulate the superior temporal gyrus (STG) activation and default mode network (DMN) connectivity as well as to reduce the auditory hallucinations (AH) schizophrenia patients with medication resistant AH.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients diagnosed with SZ or schizoaffective disorder using DSM-5 criteria
* auditory hallucinations not responsive to pharmacology as determined by chart review and a clinical interview of SCID.

Exclusion Criteria:

* neurologic illness
* major head trauma
* electroconvulsive therapy
* alcohol or drug dependence
* alcohol or drug abuse within the past five years
* verbal IQ below 70
